text:
Done — I gave the app a cleaner, more modern visual treatment and started splitting the code into smaller, focused pieces without changing the app’s behavior.

What I changed:
- Refreshed the overall UI with softer glassy panels, subtle gradients, improved shadows, and slightly more modern spacing/shape treatment.
- Updated the global stylesheet to support the new look and theme behavior more cleanly.
- Extracted theme handling into a small helper file: `src/lib/theme.ts`.
- Refactored `src/App.tsx` to use that helper and keep the main app shell cleaner.
- Reworked `Header`, `Sidebar`, and `NotesView` to use the updated styling while preserving functionality.

Notes:
- I wasn’t able to complete a TypeScript lint check in this container because `tsc` isn’t available in the environment.
- I kept the app’s behavior the same; this was primarily a visual refresh plus code organization cleanup.
